summary: All Gravy (formerly Butter Solutions), founded in 2020 in Copenhagen by Jonatan Mark Rasmussen and Kristian Lundager, makes an AI-powered employee engagement/workforce app for frontline hospitality and retail teams, used at 1,000+ shops and restaurants including Wahaca, Dishoom, Honest Burgers, Pizza Pilgrims and Ottolenghi.
All Gravy raised $2.9M (~EUR 2.6M) in funding announced in March 2025 to expand its Gen Z-focused frontline workforce platform in the UK.
The current All Gravy website contains differing customer-scale counts, including 350+ hospitality brands and 250+ hospitality groups.
